about: A great cat with long fangs; it growls low and roars before it pounces.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A big cat growls low and rumbles a deep purring growl, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big cat snarls and roars sharply, three separate snarls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big cat yowls in pain, four separate yowls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big cat gives a long weak dying moan, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A big cat lunges with a vicious snarling bite, five separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Soft heavy paws of a big cat walking on earth: muffled padded steps, well spaced. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
